### Section 1: Feminist Structure Signal

* **Proposed Title (Chinese & English)**: A.I.R. Gallery 启动筹款回归曼哈顿：在西村 Federal Archive Building 建设全新 2400 平方英尺空间与女性主义艺术文献库 / A.I.R. Gallery Announces Capital Campaign for New Home in Manhattan's Federal Archive Building
* **Source URL**: `https://www.airgallery.org/capital-campaign`
* **Publication Date**: October 2026
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Founded in SoHo in 1972 as the first all-female artist-run gallery in the United States, A.I.R. Gallery has announced a $650,000 capital campaign ($438,000 raised to date) to move from Brooklyn back to Manhattan.
  * Its new home will be at the historic Federal Archive Building in the West Village, doubling its physical space to 2,400 square feet.
  * The facility will feature three 450-square-foot exhibition galleries for solo and group exhibitions, alongside a dedicated, publicly accessible Feminist Art Library storing books and archival materials on women and non-binary artists.
  * Reopening is scheduled for early 2027.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Directly addresses physical feminist infrastructure, artist-led non-profit governance, long-term archival preservation, and spatial access for women/non-binary creators.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. No previous mention in recent issues.

### Section 2: Visual Culture Signal

* **Proposed Title (Chinese & English)**: 英国国家肖像馆开幕 Tim Walker 酷儿历史特展《Fairyland》：以 250 幅肖像跨越半个世纪的行动主义与群体记忆 / Tim Walker Traces Five Decades of Queer History in 'Fairyland' at the National Portrait Gallery
* **Source URL**: `https://www.designboom.com/art/tim-walker-fairyland-queer-activism-portraiture-national-portrait-gallery-10-09-2026/`
* **Publication Date**: October 9, 2026
* **Verified Facts**:
  * Opening October 9, 2026 at the National Portrait Gallery in London (on view through February 7, 2027), curated by Susanna Brown with set design by Shona Heath.
  * Features around 250 portraits shot over five years by Tim Walker, capturing Queer activists, performers, and cultural figures across generations.
  * Reclaims the slur "fairy" as identity and belonging, linking 1970s–80s Gay Liberation Front and Stonewall activists (e.g. Olivette Cole-Wilson, Lisa Power) with contemporary figures like Isaac Julien, Ian McKellen, and Chappell Roan.
  * Borrows visual elements from 16th-century Tudor portraiture (Holbein, Hilliard) to position marginalized figures as an imagined aristocracy.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Focuses on portraiture, image history, reclaiming language through visual culture, and how institutional archives document grassroots activism.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. No previous mention in recent issues.

### Section 3: China / East Asia Signal

* **Proposed Title (Chinese & English)**: 第八届 T3 东京摄影节开幕：以“&（と）”为主题，在城市公共空间集中呈现 17 场摄影展 / T3 Photo Festival Tokyo 2026 Opens Across the City Under the Theme '& (to)'
* **Source URL**: `https://t3photo.tokyo/`
* **Publication Date**: October 3, 2026
* **Verified Facts**:
  * The 8th T3 Photo Festival Tokyo runs from October 3 to 26, 2026 across Tokyo’s Yaesu, Nihonbashi, Kyobashi, and Ginza districts.
  * Guided by festival director Ihiro Hayami under the theme “&（と）” (the Japanese conjunction "and"), exploring relationships beyond binary oppositions.
  * Features 17 free exhibitions with over 18 artists/collectives, including Zanele Muholi's *When Things Become a Crown* (reclaiming domestic labor objects into crowns) and Lucas Foglia's *Constant Bloom*.
  * Accompanied by *T3 PHOTO ASIA 2026* art fair (October 17–19) bringing together 24 Asian photography galleries.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Highlights East Asian urban curatorial strategies, public photo interventions, domestic labor/identity politics in visual art, and regional photobook/gallery networks.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. No previous mention in recent issues.

### Section 4: AI Research / Creative Tech Signal

* **Proposed Title (Chinese & English)**: AutoTrust 在 Hugging Face 开源 JEV-27B-VL 决策模型：为 AI Agent 赋予画面与 UI 交互的白盒判断力 / AutoTrust Releases JEV-27B-VL Open Decision Model on Hugging Face for Agentic Vision and UI Interaction
* **Source URL**: `https://huggingface.co/autotrust`
* **Publication Date**: October 8, 2026
* **Verified Facts**:
  * AutoTrust AI released JEV-27B-VL under the Apache-2.0 license on Hugging Face, climbing to #1 on Hugging Face's global trending list in October 2026.
  * It is an open-weights multimodal decision model optimized for AI agents to inspect screens, UI layouts, documents, and camera feeds.
  * Decouples fast "System 1" action probability generation from "System 2" reasoning backbones, enabling explicit probability outputs (e.g. median 209ms latency) without returning unstructured prose.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Materially advances AI-native creative workflows, visual media inspection, and white-box control over UI/screen interaction for automated tools.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. Replaces ComfyUI v0.39 (covered in issue 2026-10-09) to avoid tool/version repetition.

### Section 5: Archive / Long Read / Opportunity

* **Proposed Title (Chinese & English)**: 亚洲文化协会启动 2027 年度资助申请：四类奖助金全额支持跨国艺术驻留与档案研究 / Asian Cultural Council Opens Applications for 2027 Fellowships and Grants
* **Source URL**: `https://www.asianculturalcouncil.org/grant-opportunities-2027`
* **Publication Date**: October 1, 2026
* **Verified Facts**:
  * The Asian Cultural Council (ACC) opened its 2027 Global Funding Cycle, accepting online applications from October 1 through November 10, 2026.
  * Offers 4 distinct grant categories: New York Fellowship (6-month NYC residency), Individual Fellowship (1–6 months flexible research), Graduate Fellowship, and Organization Grant.
  * Supports process-driven research, cultural immersion, and cross-border exchange between Asia and the US, as well as within Asia, across 16 disciplines including visual arts, photography, curation, and art history.
* **Relevance to Muki**: Directly serves as a high-value funding and residency lead for East Asian curators, artists, and photography history researchers.
* **Duplication Assessment**: New signal. No previous mention in recent issues.
